chemistry-killer-04.title: 25 °C irratti $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$
chemistry-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-04.material:
25 °C irratti $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M 50 mL irratti $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ koncentireeshiniin isaa hin beekamne v mL itti dabaluun ho'a olaanaa dhangala'aa makame safaree. Dhangala'aa lamaan makamuu dura ho'i lamaanuu 20.0 °C dha.
Bal'ina HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Ho'a olaanaa makamuu booda (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Dhangala'aan makame cuunfaa 1.0 g/mL, ho'a addaa 4.0 J/(g·°C), bal'inni isaa ida'ama dhangala'aa lamaan dha, ho'i hin dhabamu. Raawwiin wal-gatii $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ dha. Koncentireeshinii HCl(aq) fi ho'a wal-gatii (hammaa ho'aa bishaan 1 mol uumamu baasamu, kJ/mol) tartiibaan kan sirrii ta'een wal-qabsiisi kam?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
25 °C irratti $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M 50 mL irratti $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ koncentireeshiniin isaa hin beekamne v mL itti dabaluun ho'a olaanaa dhangala'aa makame safaree. Dhangala'aa lamaan makamuu dura ho'i lamaanuu 20.0 °C dha.
Bal'ina HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Ho'a olaanaa makamuu booda (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Dhangala'aan makame cuunfaa 1.0 g/mL, ho'a addaa 4.0 J/(g·°C), bal'inni isaa ida'ama dhangala'aa lamaan dha, ho'i hin dhabamu. Raawwiin wal-gatii $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ dha. Koncentireeshinii HCl(aq) fi ho'a wal-gatii (hammaa ho'aa bishaan 1 mol uumamu baasamu, kJ/mol) tartiibaan kan sirrii ta'een wal-qabsiisi kam?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: v yoo dabalu ho'i ol-ba'a, 25 mL irratti 29.0 °C olaanaa ta'a, boodas dhangala'aa wal-hin-gatin dabalaa (bal'inni dhangala'aa waliigalaa dabalu) waan dhufuuf gad-bu'a. Kanaaf 25 mL irratti H+ fi OH- hir'inaa fi dabaleen malee raawwatu.
Tarkaanfii 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) fi HCl 1:1 waan raawwatuuf HCl 0.050 mol 25 mL keessa jira. Koncentireeshinii = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
Tarkaanfii 3: Hammaa ho'aa Q = mcΔT = (50+25 mL × 1.0 g/mL) × 4.0 × 9.0 = 75 × 4.0 × 9.0 = 2700 J.
Tarkaanfii 4: Ho'a wal-gatii = 2700 J ÷ 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Mirkaneessa: v = 10 mL yoo ta'e H+ 0.020 mol hundi raawwata, ΔT = 0.020 × 54000 ÷ (60 × 4.0) = 4.5 → 24.5 °C. v = 40 mL yoo ta'e OH- 0.050 mol hundi raawwata, ΔT = 2700 ÷ (90 × 4.0) = 7.5 → 27.5 °C.
Deebii: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Deebii dogoggoraa: 36 kJ/mol ulfaatina dhangala'aa 50 g jedhee, 108 kJ/mol bishaan uumame 0.025 mol jedhee lakkaa'uun argame dha)
chemistry-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
